films.title: Tears of Steel
films.synopsis: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists and fighters recreate a moment from the past in an attempt to stop a robot catastrophe. A complete live-action science-fiction short film with visual effects.
films.content_advisory: Science-fiction violence, weapons, threatening robots and some strong language. Editorial guidance, not an official certification.
films.attribution: Tears of Steel (2012), Blender Foundation | mango.blender.org. Directed by Ian Hubert.

films.title: Sintel
films.synopsis: A young traveler searches for the dragon she once rescued. Her journey through a harsh fantasy world leads to an unexpected discovery. A complete animated fantasy short film.
films.content_advisory: Fantasy combat, injury, blood and the death of a creature. Editorial guidance, not an official certification.
films.attribution: Sintel (2010), copyright Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org. Directed by Colin Levy.

films.title: Big Buck Bunny
films.audio_description: No spoken dialogue; music, sound effects and English credits
films.synopsis: A gentle rabbit's peaceful day is interrupted by three mischievous forest animals. He responds with an elaborate plan of his own. A complete animated comedy short film with no spoken dialogue.
films.content_advisory: Cartoon bullying, slapstick violence and harm to small creatures. Editorial guidance, not an official certification.
films.attribution: Copyright 2008, Blender Foundation / www.bigbuckbunny.org. Directed by Sacha Goedegebure. Source: official remastered edition.
